description: Get one published Morereply analysis by its share token, its page URL (https://morereply.com/poll/{id}/stats/{token}) or a short link. Returns each demographic group's filter, voter count and option percentages, as stored when the author published it.

analysis.description: Analysis share token, analysis page URL, or morereply.com/p/ short link

name: get_analysis

filter.description: Who belongs to the group, as stored by the author

id.description: Option id; pass it to vote

percent.description: Share of the poll's option votes, 0 to 100; absent while results are hidden

votes.description: Votes for this option; absent while results are hidden

title: Get published analysis
